name: Link
description: A single link with its two neighbours cut by the cell edge.

code.style: --rule: ( --rot: @pick(0deg, 90deg); @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 4%; top: 18%; width: 92%; height: 64%; border-radius: 999px; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, transparent 66%, #000 66%); mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, transparent 66%, #000 66%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: -46%; top: 18%; width: 92%; height: 64%; border-radius: 999px; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, transparent 66%, #000 66%); mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, transparent 66%, #000 66%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } -webkit-transform: rotate(@var(--rot)); transform: rotate(@var(--rot)); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
